skills.name: Burning of Xinye
skills.effect: Deals direct damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 2000). If the target is a rallied army, reduces its skill damage (30%), affecting up to 5 nearby enemy troops.

skills.name: Weeping Queen
skills.effect: Archer units gain increased Defense, deal extra damage to infantry, and take reduced normal attack damage when the troop is archer-only.

skills.name: Queenly Zeal
skills.effect: Archer units led by this commander gain increased Attack. While garrisoned in a Stronghold or your city, normal attacks have a chance to inflict the Ambushed effect on the target troop for 3 seconds, which prevents the target from benefiting from effects triggered by being surrounded. Triggers once every 8 seconds.

skills.name: Beacon of Byrsa
skills.effect: While garrisoned in a Stronghold or your city, archer units gain increased Health and can reduce incoming skill damage once every 10 seconds.

skills.name: Queen's Malediction
skills.effect: Archer units led by this commander gain 40% increased Attack. While garrisoned in a Stronghold or your city, normal attacks have a 30% chance to reduce the target's Defense by 40% and inflict the Ambushed effect for 3 seconds. Triggers once every 8 seconds.

commanders.name: Huo Qubing

skills.name: General of Agile Cavalry
skills.effect: Deals direct damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 2,700, 1,350 if serving as secondary commander) and reduces its March Speed by 50% for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Ferghana Horses
skills.effect: Cavalry units led by this commander gain 40% increased Attack. While outside of alliance territory, their cavalry units gain 15% increased March Speed and deal 5% more damage to archer units.

skills.name: Dragon of the Desert
skills.effect: If this commander's troop has not been garrisoned in a building for at least 30 seconds, every time their troop enters combat it gains the following buffs for the first 15 seconds of the battle: it deals 30% more skill damage; active skills cost 150 less Rage to use.

skills.name: Battlefield Appropriations
skills.effect: When attacking an enemy troop, cavalry units led by this commander gain 30% increased Defense and their troop deals 20% more skill damage. Whenever their troop defeats an enemy troop, some of its slightly wounded units will be healed (Healing Factor 1,500).

skills.name: Conquerer of Khentii
skills.effect: When attacking an enemy troop, cavalry units led by this commander gain 35% increased Defense and their troop deals 25% more skill damage. Whenever their troop defeats an enemy troop, it gains the Autumn Wind effect and some of its slightly wounded units will be healed (Healing Factor 3,000).
